text:
alex: Quick heads-up — after the RoPE gamma scaling change merged yesterday I'm seeing a regression on the Mistral/Mixtral blended runtime (hosted-dedicated). Rough numbers: ~25% drop in tokens/sec for the GQA workload when paged KV is enabled.

mira: ugh, good catch. Can you paste the profiler / kernel list and the model config you used?

alex: copying logs + config (shortened):
```\nModel: mistral-7b-mixtral-setup
model_config:
  num_key_value_heads: 16
  kv_dim_per_head: 64
  paged_kv_slot_size: 8192
  rope_scale: 1.18
  use_paged_kv: true

Profiler snapshot (summary):
  kv_read_unified_kernel        22.4ms   (20%)
  kv_read_paged_coalesced      61.3ms   (55%)
  attention_matmul             18.1ms   (16%)
  other                        8.7ms    (9%)
  p50 latency: 42ms -> 52ms after patch
  tokens/sec: 920 -> 690 (GQA batch shape)

Notes: kernel picker picked 'kv_read_paged_coalesced' much more often post-RoPE-change, even for requests with irregular head stride.
```

sam: I think this is a head alignment / stride issue. RoPE scaling changes the effective rotary freq -> we re-aligned interleaving differently in the tokenizer/mmap layout, which can change memory stride on paged KV. If stride becomes non-coalesced the runtime falls back to a slower path.

kai: can we force a kernel hint and see? env var exists: RUNTIME_KERNEL_HINT=coalesced|fallback. Also try num_key_value_heads=32 (remaps layout) to see if that restores coalescing.

alex: ran two quick local runs:
- num_key_value_heads=32, same rope_scale: tokens/sec -> 815 (partial recovery, p50 46ms)
- same as above + RUNTIME_KERNEL_HINT=coalesced: tokens/sec -> 980 (back above baseline)
So forcing kernel and increasing heads both helped.

mira: data point suggests kernel selection logic is mis-evaluating stride when rope_scale != 1. It probably computes expected head stride from (num_heads, kv_dim) but RoPE scale/packing changed effective alignments. We need a reliable detection at runtime (inspect pointer alignment & per-head stride) rather than derived heuristic.

sam: Agreed. Short-term mitigation: (1) add runtime env override to prefer coalesced paged kernel for affected models, (2) add an autoswitch experiment that instruments a few requests to check actual memory access pattern and picks kernel accordingly. Long-term: upstream kernel picker change to measure real stride.

perf-bot: scheduled nightly-bench run: bench-4822 (mistral-7b, paged-kv, rope_scale=1.18) — results will post in #eng-runtime-bench at 03:00 UTC.

alex: created quick patch (WIP) that exposes runtime flag --force-paged-coalesced and added a tiny probe that samples the first 8 token accesses to decide kernel. Patch link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/1234 (comments welcome).

mira: for the fix, also consider model-specific config override: some Mixtral variants use kv_head_packing=interleaved; others use contiguous. We should make the picker aware of packing mode as explicit metadata coming from model catalog so we don't rely on heuristics.

kai: action items:
- mira: file an RFC for catalog metadata for kv_packing & rope_scale (assign you)
- sam: add a short probe check in kernel picker + metrics (p99 to Perf/alert if fallback chosen unexpectedly)
- alex: run bench-4822 with force-coalesced disabled/enabled and paste results in thread when done

sam: small note — when we increase num_key_value_heads from 16->32 we doubled head count but halved per-head kv_dim -> that changes the per-head cache working set and often reduces cross-head striding. It's a useful experiment but has memory/layout tradeoffs; prefer picker fix.

alex: posting quick bench results (final):
- baseline (pre-RoPE change): tokens/sec 940
- post-RoPE (no mitigation): 690
- num_kv_heads=32: 815
- force-coalesced kernel: 985
- probe-based auto switch (experimental): 970

mira: nice. Let's merge the probe-based auto-switch as a stopgap and track a catalog + picker refactor for a medium-term fix. I'll open the RFC and link the probe PRs.

kai: and please add a regression test in the nightly bench matrix that toggles rope_scale to 1.0/1.18 and checks kernel choice stability across paged-kv layouts.

alex: will do — I'll also add a tiny peri-call metric (kernel_hint_applied=true/false) for 7 days so we can roll back if it causes flakiness.

sam: thanks everyone. Good catch and good triage. :thumbsup:
